arxiv-2203-11020.description: Abstract Taking advantage of the now available Gaia EDR3 parallaxes, we carry out an archival Hubble Space Telescope (HST) far ultraviolet spectroscopic analysis of 10 cataclysmic variable systems, including 5 carefully selected eclipsing systems. We obtain accurate white dwarf (WD) masses and temperatures, in excellent agreement with the masses for 4 of the eclipsing systems.

arxiv-2205-08239.title: CAS-Net: Conditional Atlas Generation and Brain Segmentation for Fetal MRI
arxiv-2205-08239.creator: Liu Li ( ✉ ) {}^{(\textrm{{\char 0\relax}})}, Qiang Ma, Matthew Sinclair, Antonios Makropoulos, Joseph Hajnal, A. David Edwards, Bernhard Kainz, Daniel Rueckert, Amir Alansary
arxiv-2205-08239.description: Abstract Fetal Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is used in prenatal diagnosis and to assess early brain development. Accurate segmentation of the different brain tissues is a vital step in several brain analysis tasks, such as cortical surface reconstruction and tissue thickness measurements.

arxiv-2210-00109.title: How to Identify Different New Neutrino Oscillation Physics Scenarios at DUNE
arxiv-2210-00109.creator: Peter B. Denton, Alessio Giarnetti, and Davide Meloni
arxiv-2210-00109.description: Abstract Next generation neutrino oscillation experiments are expected to measure the remaining oscillation parameters with very good precision. They will have unprecedented capabilities to search for new physics that modify oscillations. DUNE, with its broad band beam, good particle identification, and relatively high energies will provide an excellent environment to search for new physics.

arxiv-2309-05798.title: Enhancing Hyperedge Prediction with Context-Aware Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2309-05798.creator: Yunyong Ko, Hanghang Tong, and Sang-Wook Kim 1
arxiv-2309-05798.description: Abstract Hypergraphs can naturally model group-wise relations (e.g., a group of users who co-purchase an item) as hyperedges . Hyperedge prediction is to predict future or unobserved hyperedges, which is a fundamental task in many real-world applications (e.g., group recommendation).

arxiv-2501-09363.title: Identification of Traditional Medicinal Plant Leaves Using an effective Deep Learning model and Self-Curated Dataset
arxiv-2501-09363.creator: Deepjyoti Chetia, Dr. Sanjib Kr Kalita, Prof Partha Pratim Baruah, Debasish Dutta, Tanaz Akhter
arxiv-2501-09363.description: Abstract Medicinal plants have been a key component in producing traditional and modern medicines, especially in the field of Ayurveda, an ancient Indian medical system. Producing these medicines and collecting and extracting the right plant is a crucial step due to the visually similar nature of some plants. The extraction of these plants from non-medicinal plants requires human expert intervention.

arxiv-2502-21209.title: End-to-End Deep Learning in Phase Noisy Coherent Optical Link
arxiv-2502-21209.creator: Omar Alnaseri 1 , and Yassine Himeur 4
arxiv-2502-21209.description: Abstract In coherent optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) fiber communications, a novel end-to-end learning framework to mitigate Laser Phase Noise (LPN) impairments is proposed in this paper. Inspired by Autoencoder (AE) principles, the proposed approach trains a model to learn robust symbol sequences capable of combat LPN, even from low-cost distributed feedback (DFB) lasers with linewidths up to 2 MHz.

arxiv-2504-04022.title: Rethinking Reflection in Pre-Training
arxiv-2504-04022.creator: Essential AI
arxiv-2504-04022.description: Abstract A language model’s ability to reflect on its own reasoning provides a key advantage for solving complex problems. While most recent research has focused on how this ability develops during reinforcement learning, we show that it actually begins to emerge much earlier—during the model’s pre-training.

arxiv-2509-26557.title: The Invisible Mentor: Inferring User Actions from Screen Recordings to Recommend Better Workflows CCS: Human-centered computing Interactive systems and tools
arxiv-2509-26557.creator: Litao Yan, Andrew Head, Ken Milne, Vu Le, Sumit Gulwani, Chris Parnin, Emerson Murphy-Hill
arxiv-2509-26557.description: Abstract . Many users struggle to notice when a more efficient workflow exists in feature-rich tools like Excel. Existing AI assistants offer help only after users describe their goals or problems, which can be effortful and imprecise. We present InvisibleMentor, a system that turns screen recordings of task completion into vision-grounded task reflection.

pmc-11635293.creator: Lucía Campos-Prieto, Aitor García-Rey, Eddy Sotelo, Ana Mallo-Abreu, Thomas J J Müller
pmc-11635293.description: The ongoing quest to discover effective treatments for diseases remains a significant challenge for the scientific community. Multicomponent reactions (MCRs) have emerged as powerful tools in accelerating drug discovery, enabling the rapid generation of chemical libraries with high diversity in a time-efficient and environmentally sustainable manner.

pmc-12381571.title: Navigating the Prognostic Complexity of IgH Cytogenetic Abnormalities in Multiple Myeloma Among Diverse IgH Cytogenetic Abnormalities–Involved High‐Risk Stratifications

pmc-12381571.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the clinical and prognostic significance of immunoglobulin heavy chain (IgH) cytogenetic abnormalities in patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM) and explore their association with other high‐risk cytogenetic features.Patients and MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 503 NDMM patients treated between February 1, 2016, and February 29, 2024. Cytogenetic abnormalities were identified by fluorescence in situ hybridization.

pmc-12394829.title: Gelatin-based materials: fabrication, properties and applications in the food packaging system
pmc-12394829.creator: Xiaoxue Xu, Yuewei Xi, Yunxuan Weng
pmc-12394829.description: As a natural biodegradable polymer derived from animal proteins, gelatin exhibits significant potential in environmentally friendly food packaging. This review briefly outlines the preparation and cross-linking methods of gelatin, explores the regulatory mechanisms of different cross-linking strategies on material properties, and analyzes the multi-form application characteristics of gelatin in packaging, elucidating its structure–property relationships.

pmc-12560514.title: From intervention studies to national programs, what are the favoring and hindering factors? a scoping review
pmc-12560514.creator: Renata Cristina Ferreira Rola, Tatiana Rivera Ramirez, Axel Kroeger
pmc-12560514.description: BackgroundThe translation of successful health projects into public health practice is among the most relevant challenges to pursue better health results, including the outcomes established by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Healthcare interventions proven cost-effective should be expanded into broader policies and practices. This process is called scaling-up and its success depends on several factors.

pmc-13046097.title: Evaluation of a Contactless Sleep Monitoring Device for Sleep Stage Detection at Home in a Healthy Population: Prospective Study in Free-Living Conditions

pmc-13046097.description: BackgroundSleep is essential for overall health and well-being, but assessing sleep architecture is often costly and time-consuming, relying primarily on polysomnography (PSG). While wrist-worn wearables offer alternatives, they face limitations regarding user compliance, such as battery charging and physical discomfort. Nearable devices address these burdens, but they regularly lack rigorous validation, especially in real-world settings.

pmc-13068530.title: ATM inhibition restores IFN-γ sensitivity and induces ferroptosis in NSCLC via DNA damage response
pmc-13068530.creator: Muhammad Irshad Farooq, Sisca Ucche, Mariho Uozumi, Sana Jabbar, Suthasinee Seephan, So-Ichiro Sasaki, Yoshihiro Hayakawa
pmc-13068530.description: Cancer immunotherapy has demonstrated remarkable clinical success across diverse tumor types. Nevertheless, durable responses occur in only a subset of patients, and both primary and acquired resistance remain major challenges. Interferon-γ (IFN-γ), a key effector cytokine in anti-tumor immunity, is often neutralized by tumor cells through mechanisms that attenuate its activity.

pmc-13145954.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1794 INTEGRATED MULTI-OMICS FACTOR ANALYSIS IDENTIFIES EARLY MOLECULAR SIGNATURES OF BRAIN INJURY IN ISCHEMIC STROKE

pmc-13145954.description: Background and aimsAcute ischemic brain injury could be reflected in systemic molecular dynamics that may support patient monitoring and stratification. We leveraged serial multi-omics in acute stroke to identify circulating molecular signatures capturing key mechanisms of brain injury, such as reperfusion injury, oxidative stress, and inflammation.
